contea di ritrovamento: Suffolk (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy contemporary copy of a Roman radiate (Barbarous radiate), copying a coin of an unclear ruler, dating to AD 275-285 (Reece Period 14). Copying an unclear reverse type depicting a standing figure right holding wreath or patera in left hand, corrupted legend reading [...] VSV[...] with invereted S. Prototype mint unclear
